outcome: Admission to the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
cohort: The study included eighty-one first-trimester women with a history of adverse pregnancy outcomes who were undergoing low-molecular-weight heparin (LMWH) therapy during pregnancy.
finding: Anti-FXa levels measured in the first trimester did not show an influence on pregnancy and fetal outcomes.
mod_finding: Anti-FXa levels did not have a relationship with type of delivery or cesarean indications.
followup_time: Until birth and immediate postpartum period
